question_content: Summary: Thunderbird intermittently fails to download certain POP emails that are visible in Mailwasher Pro. Some messages download normally, others disappear from Mailwasher (as expected after a successful POP retrieval) but never appear in Thunderbird. No error messages are shown. Environment: •	Email client: Thunderbird (current version) •	Account type: POP3 •	Anti spam tool: Mailwasher Pro •	OS: Windows 10/11 •	Mailwasher behaviour: Messages appear correctly in MW’s inbox list. •	Thunderbird behaviour: Using Get Messages retrieves some emails, but others vanish from MW without being written into Thunderbird’s Inbox. Detailed Behaviour: 7.	Mailwasher shows new incoming messages normally. 8.	When Thunderbird performs a POP “Get Messages”: •	Some messages download correctly into Thunderbird’s Inbox and disappear from MW (expected). •	Other messages disappear from MW (as if retrieved) but do not appear in Thunderbird. 9.	These “evaporated” messages are not: •	In Inbox •	In Junk •	In Trash •	In Local Folders •	In any filter redirected folder 10.	No error dialog appears in Thunderbird. 11. Suspected Areas: •	Thunderbird POP retrieval logic intermittently failing to write messages to Inbox. •	Possible interaction between MW’s “hand off to mail client” and Thunderbird’s POP session. •	Potential profile corruption or POP state file corruption (popstate.dat). •	Possible Thunderbird bug affecting selective message retrieval. Assistance Requested: •	How to diagnose POP retrieval failures where messages vanish from MW but do not appear in Thunderbird. •	Whether Thunderbird logs can show POP level message acceptance or rejection. •	Whether popstate.dat or Inbox file corruption could cause selective message loss. •	Recommended steps to isolate MW interaction vs Thunderbird internal handling.
